reason: I don't put an unknown bot in my staff chat or sign it into my Google account. It would read everything people write there, not only receipts. The missing papers at month end bother me, but not enough to hand that over to someone I don't know.
objection: Who is behind this bot, and what happens to my chats and my Google Drive once it has access? Also, my staff might go back to their old habits once the free documents run out, and then I'm paying $19 every month for nothing.
would_change_my_mind: If it could work only from receipts I forward myself, with no access to the group chat and only to one sheet it creates, not my whole Google account. And if my accountant or another shop owner here told me they use it safely.
